prompt: How many years had the then-Prime Minister of France been in office as PM when the first Shelby GT500 was built?
answer:
The first Shelby GT500 was built in **1967**. France’s Prime Minister at the time was **Georges Pompidou**, who had been in office since **April 1962**.

So, he had been Prime Minister for **about 5 years**.
